meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证并规划本地基因组间隔工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理基因组数据并需要验证BED文件
copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic data and need to validate BED files

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能指导你处理 BED 格式的基因组区间数据：验证文件和“universe”参考区间是否合格，规划 Region2Vec 或 scEmbed 的机器学习训练，检查模型与分词器的兼容性，并评估 consensus 峰值集合。
howto.when: 当你说到 BED 文件、Region2Vec/scEmbed、consensus 峰值等关键词，或要求做基因组区域的机器学习分析时，会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 BED 文件目录做 Region2Vec 嵌入训练
say.note: Claude 会给出分词、训练和评估的步骤。

say.text: 我的单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据该用 scEmbed 怎么分析？
say.note: Claude 会引导加载数据、预分词、训练和聚类。

say.text: 检查一下刚构建的 universe 峰值集合是否合格
say.note: Claude 会运行评估并提示覆盖率和质量指标。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can guide you through BED-format genomic interval workflows: validating BED files and universe references, planning Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, checking model/tokenizer compatibility, and assessing consensus peak sets.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention BED files, Region2Vec/scEmbed, consensus peaks, or ask for ML analysis of genomic regions.

say_en.text: Help me train Region2Vec embeddings on this BED folder.
say_en.note: Claude will outline tokenization, training, and evaluation.

say_en.text: How should I analyze my scATAC-seq data with scEmbed?
say_en.note: Claude will guide loading, pre-tokenization, training, and clustering.

say_en.text: Check if my newly built universe peak set is valid.
say_en.note: Claude will run evaluation and report coverage and quality.
